product_overview: UrbanCart is a luxury e-commerce storefront with curated discovery, interactive 3D product inspection, and a streamlined shopping and checkout experience. It also includes an authenticated backoffice for managing orders, inventory, and catalog content.
core_goals: Browse curated luxury products by category and promotion
Filter, search, sort, and inspect products in detail before purchase
Save items to wishlist and manage items in cart
Complete purchase through a protected multi-step checkout flow
Review past orders and shipment progress
Sign in, register, reset password, and manage customer account details
Use admin tools to monitor operations and update product and order data

features.name: Homepage Discovery & Promotions
features.description: The storefront homepage lets shoppers explore curated categories, flash deals, promotional offers, and newsletter signup from a luxury editorial landing page.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Observe the hero promotion, category showcase, best sellers, new arrivals, and flash deal content -> Select a category to browse a filtered catalog
Navigate to / -> Copy the seasonal promo code -> Observe the flash deals countdown timer
Navigate to / -> Enter an email address for the newsletter -> Submit the subscription form -> See the subscription confirmation state

features.name: Catalog Search & Multi-Attribute Filtering
features.description: The catalog helps shoppers find products by category, price, search keywords, and sort order before opening a product detail page.
user_flows: Navigate to /shop -> Browse the product catalog -> Select a category filter -> Adjust the maximum price range -> Enter search terms -> Choose a sort option -> Review the narrowed results
Navigate to /shop -> Open a product card -> See the product detail page
Navigate to /category/:category -> Review products already filtered to a specific category -> Refine the results with search, price, or sort controls

features.name: 3D Product Detail Inspection
features.description: The product detail page provides image galleries, interactive 3D inspection, variant selection, product specifications, and customer reviews.
user_flows: Navigate to /product/:id -> View the product gallery and details -> Open the interactive 3D studio -> Rotate the model and switch lighting presets -> Select a colorway -> Select a size -> Add the item to the bag
Navigate to /product/:id -> Review the materials, provenance, and specifications -> Read customer reviews
Navigate to /product/:id -> Write a customer review -> Submit the review -> See the posted review reflected in the reviews section

features.name: Wishlist Management
features.description: The wishlist page lets shoppers review saved items, compare prices, add items to cart, or remove items they no longer want.
user_flows: Navigate to /wishlist -> Review saved items and price comparisons -> Add a saved item to the cart -> Return to the wishlist to continue browsing
Navigate to /wishlist -> Remove an item from the saved list -> See the wishlist update

features.name: Shopping Cart & Promo Codes
features.description: The cart page lets shoppers adjust line items, apply a promo code, and continue into checkout.
user_flows: Navigate to /cart -> Review cart items and totals -> Increase or decrease an item quantity -> See the subtotal update
Navigate to /cart -> Enter the promo code URBAN20 -> Apply the code -> See the discount reflected in the order total
Navigate to /cart -> Remove an item from the cart -> Continue to checkout

features.name: Multi-Currency Live Conversion
features.description: Shoppers can switch displayed prices across supported currencies and see updated prices throughout the storefront and cart.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the currency selector -> Choose a different currency -> Observe prices update across the storefront
Navigate to /cart -> Open the currency selector -> Choose a different currency -> Observe cart totals recalculate in the selected currency

features.name: Customer Authentication & Password Reset
features.description: Customers can sign in, register a new account, or reset a password from the standalone authentication pages.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter an email address or mobile number and password -> Submit the sign-in form -> See the authenticated state
Navigate to /login -> Choose the register option -> Enter name, email, phone, and password -> Submit the registration form -> See account creation completion
Navigate to /forgot-password -> Request a verification code -> Enter the 6-digit OTP -> Set a new password -> Submit the reset form -> See the password reset completion

features.name: Multi-Step Checkout & Order Placement
features.description: Authenticated shoppers can complete a four-step checkout by entering shipping information, choosing delivery and payment options, and placing the order.
user_flows: Navigate to /checkout -> Enter shipping destination details -> Select a delivery method -> Select a payment method -> Review the order summary -> Authorize the order -> See the order success confirmation
Navigate to /checkout -> Attempt to continue without completing required shipping or payment details -> See validation prompts prevent submission

features.name: Order Confirmation & Tracking
features.description: After purchase, shoppers can view the order success page, confirm reference details, and review previous orders and shipment progress.
user_flows: Navigate to /order-success -> Review the order reference code and delivery timeline -> Download the receipt
Navigate to /orders -> Review past orders, totals, and delivery milestones -> Open an order detail view -> Inspect itemized order information and courier details

features.name: Backoffice Admin Console
features.description: Administrators can review KPIs, manage orders, and add or edit catalog products from the protected admin area.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Review KPI cards and operational summaries -> Switch between dashboard sections -> Update an order fulfillment status
Navigate to /admin -> Open the product editor -> Enter product attributes -> Submit the new product -> See the catalog update
Navigate to /admin -> Review the customer directory and inventory information -> Use the admin tools to manage store operations

routes.description: Homepage featuring curated hero banner, category showcase, best-selling products, new arrivals, flash deals with live countdown, promo coupon banner, customer reviews, and newsletter subscription.
Master goods catalog with multi-category filters, price range slider, sort options, and live search.
Filtered catalog view for specific merchandise category.
Product detail view with gallery, interactive 3D WebGL studio viewer, colorway swatches, size selection, stock status, specs, provenance, and customer reviews.
Saved customer wishlist items with quick add-to-cart, remove, and price comparison.
Shopping cart review page with quantity adjusters, promo code discounts, order totals, and express checkout.
Four-step luxury checkout flow including shipping destination, courier method, payment selection, and final order placement.
Order placement confirmation with reference code, delivery timeline, and receipt download.
Keyword search results page displaying matched items and category suggestions.
Customer sign-in page supporting email or mobile phone login, with Google sign-in simulation.
Account creation page for new patrons with full name, email, phone, and password.
Password reset flow with 6-digit OTP verification.
Patron account profile management, address book CRUD, payment method wallet, and security preferences.
Order history ledger showing order tracking milestones, delivery courier details, and item recap.
Itemized order dossier with tracking step updates, shipping breakdown, and receipt download.
Brand heritage, design manifesto, sustainability practices, and atelier craft story.
Customer support contact form, concierge channels, and FAQ quick links.
Accordion-style frequently asked questions regarding shipping, returns, sizing, and authentications.
Privacy policy and patron data protection disclosure.
Terms and conditions of service and order transactions.
Operations console with sales KPIs, category revenue breakdown, order status management, and customer directory.
Comprehensive catalog creation and editing suite with 11 product attribute fields.
Dedicated backoffice administrative login gateway.

features.name: Homepage Discovery & Flash Deals
features.description: Browse hero promotions, explore lifestyle categories, copy discount coupon URBAN20, observe real-time countdown timer, and subscribe to newsletter.
user_interactions: Click on Category cards to navigate to filtered shop catalog
Click 'Copy Code' on seasonal banner to copy URBAN20 promo code
Observe ticking countdown timer on Flash Deals section
Fill newsletter email field and submit subscription form
Click 'Quick View' on product cards to open modal overlay

features.name: Catalog Search & Multi-Attribute Filtering
features.description: Filter catalog items by category, price threshold, search text, and sorting criteria.
user_interactions: Click category pill buttons to filter products
Slide price range slider to restrict maximum price
Type search terms into the catalog search input
Select sort dropdown option (Price Low-High, High-Low, Rating)
Click product card to open Product Detail view

features.name: 3D Studio & Product Detail Inspection
features.description: Inspect products with procedural 3D WebGL models, toggle lighting presets (Day Studio, Moody Noir, Warm Sunset), rotate 360 degrees, select variants, and read customer reviews.
user_interactions: Click '3D Interactive Studio' tab to launch WebGL canvas
Click '360° Spin' or pause auto-rotation
Click lighting preset buttons (Day Studio, Moody Noir, Warm Sunset)
Select colorway swatches to update 3D model and image gallery
Select shoe/clothing size option
Click 'Add to Bag' button
Write and submit a customer star review

features.name: Shopping Cart & Quick Cart Drawer
features.description: Manage cart line-items, adjust quantities, toggle slide-out cart drawer, and apply coupon codes.
user_interactions: Click shopping bag icon in navigation to open CartDrawer
Click plus or minus buttons to increment or decrement item quantity
Click trash icon to remove item from cart
Input promo code URBAN20 and click Apply
Click 'Proceed to Checkout' button

features.name: Multi-Currency Live Conversion
features.description: Switch currency between INR, USD, EUR, GBP, and JPY with instant price recalculation.
user_interactions: Click currency selector in navigation bar
Select desired currency from modal (INR, USD, EUR, GBP, JPY)
Observe immediate price update across catalog and cart

features.name: User Authentication & OTP Password Reset
features.description: Sign in with email or phone, register new customer account, or reset password via 6-digit OTP.
user_interactions: Enter email or phone and password to sign in
Click 'Sign in with Google' for one-touch login simulation
Switch to Register tab and fill registration form
Request 6-digit verification code for password reset
Enter OTP code 482910 and set new password

features.name: Multi-Step Checkout & Order Placement
features.description: Step-by-step checkout with address details, courier selection, payment choice, and order creation.
user_interactions: Enter shipping address details
Select delivery courier method
Select payment method (Card / UPI / Netbanking / COD)
Click 'Confirm & Authorize Order'
Redirect to /order-success upon completion

features.name: Order History & Shipment Tracking
features.description: View previous purchases, itemized receipts, and real-time shipment progression steps.
user_interactions: View list of past orders with dates and totals
Click 'Order Details' to view itemized modal
View tracking progress bar and courier details

features.name: Backoffice Admin Console
features.description: Administrative dashboard to manage order fulfillment status, monitor catalog inventory, and view customer metrics.
user_interactions: View KPI metric cards (Total Sales, Total Orders, Total Customers, Total Products)
Switch sidebar tabs (Overview, Orders, Inventory, Customers, Settings)
Change order fulfillment status dropdown (e.g. PREPARING SHIPMENT, COURIER DISPATCHED, DELIVERED)
Click 'Add Product' to open modal with 11 product attribute fields
Fill and submit new product specifications
